record.hypothesis: Proposal key: 9b12cf0f5ee09f1916436e6a92ba10b0473e8d361d8942e9e654c589f284e0ee Mechanism: For an immutable sample plane and a declared pointwise integer lookup-table transform, compute candidate output histograms and aggregate statistics by mapping histogram counts instead of rendering and rescanning all samples. Initial scope: One exactly represented 10-bit grayscale or luma-code plane, 1,024 source bins, one fixed ROI per histogram, and pointwise 10-bit integer output LUTs. No spatial filters, local tone mapping, cross-channel transforms, dithering, or temporal adaptation. Acceptance contract: Exact output-bin counts, sample count, integer sums and squared sums where requested, and correctly defined threshold counts relative to a per-pixel application of the same LUT. Perceptual quality and full-color gamut are not inferred.
